subject: Fix swordfight RNG draw divergence (mislabeled VipIdleRemark cluster, ~80)
description: ReceiveSwordDamage subfamily fixed: Smalltalk DONE used a raw circular direction vector for Original's pAntagonist->GetDirectionVector dot-product back-hit gate. Original's vector is in the isometric map plane, with aspect-scaled Y. On Nescafe schema14 P003/S001 replay-005 this flipped the half-plane test, suppressing ReceiveSwordDamage and two SwordDamageProtection draws. The exact replay now matches frames 429-431 and a focused regression passes. REMAINING heterogeneous subfamilies: UpdateSwordfightDistance (offsets 1807002/1807253), EvaluateSwordfight (1814391), FindPositionForTableSwordfight (~1804390), and other SwordDamageProtection cases. The rng:VipIdleRemark cluster label is only the first RNG site in the divergent frame.
